messages:
samir: kicking off scheduled change window for search-indexer-service  rolling indexer-v2-quant to 12% (indexing-backfill enabled). primary checks: p95 search latency, 5xx, and disk IO saturation on indexer nodes. deploy-bot: rollout started: search-indexer-service -> indexer-v2-quant (12%). rollout id r-2026-05-05-14 :rocket:
elaine: watching /dash/slo/search-indexer. alert thresholds: p95 > 90ms or 5xx > 0.25%. also monitor node disk_io_utilization > 70%. :eyes:
chris: FYI I enabled background reindex shards in v2 to warm the new quantized index. that increases disk IO briefly. flagged in release notes.
metrics-bot: perf smoke scheduled (30s). collecting p50/p95/p99, 5xx, disk io per node.
chris: seeing disk_io_util on indexer-node-3 spike to 82% after reindex started. might be saturating shared EBS.
elaine: can you paste the query?
chris: ```query
sum(rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{instance=~"indexer-node.*"}[1m])) by (instance) * 100
```
chris: results: indexer-node-3=82%, indexer-node-2=45%, indexer-node-1=38%
elaine: p95 for search-api routing to indexer canary slice = 112ms (baseline 78ms). warning threshold exceeded. :rotating_light:
sre-bot: SLO watch: search-indexer canary p95 > 90ms (alert id slo-466). paging eng-oncall in 3m unless acknowledged.
samir: acknowledge. hold further ramp. do not advance to 40%.
chris: quick mitigation: pause reindexbackfill on canary nodes and throttle IO. I can set ENV REINDEX_THROTTLE=0.2 for canary and restart reindex controller.
chris: applying:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/indexer-reindex-controller REINDEX_THROTTLE=0.2 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/indexer-reindex-controller -n prod
```
metrics-bot: reindex-controller restart observed. IO throttle applied.
elaine: after throttle p95 trending down to 82ms in canary slice, disk_io_util on indexer-node-3 down to 56%, 5xx reduced to 0.07%.
samir: good recovery. decision: keep canary at 12% for 40m with reindex throttle engaged. if stable, resume reindex at reduced concurrency and ramp to 50%. if p95 or 5xx exceed thresholds again, rollback and pin to indexer-v1.
chris: filing follow-up INF-1150 to add pre-ramp IO dry-run check: fail if any indexer node IO > 60% in last 10m. also add a pre-ramp step that disables background reindex on canary shards. link: https://issues.redwood/INF-1150
sre-bot: note: to pin use `deployctl pin --service search-indexer-service --version indexer-v1 --reason "canary IO/p95 regression"` (immediate traffic failover).
elaine: annotating release notes with reindex IO interaction, throttle applied, and INF-1150. link: https://docs.internal/releases/search-indexer/2026-05-05
samir: also recommend adding an ephemeral warmup job that reads hot doc ids to pre-warm disk cache before ramp. chris please add to INF-1150.
chris: will add warmup job. ticket updated.
samir: thanks team. keeping thread open. we'll reconvene in 40m to decide ramp vs pin. :thumbsup:
